## SCHOLARLY + DS&A CONTEXT
# ALGORITHM: Item difficulty (p-value)
#   source:      journey-os-algorithms-scholarly.html §IX
#   complexity:  time O(n) per item · space O(1)
#   parameters:  p-value = (number correct) / (total attempts); ideal range 0.30-0.70
#   security:    N/A
#   invariants:
#     - p-value always in [0.0, 1.0]
#     - Items with p < 0.20 flagged as "too hard"
#     - Items with p > 0.90 flagged as "too easy"
#
# ALGORITHM: Item discrimination index (point-biserial correlation)
#   source:      journey-os-algorithms-scholarly.html §IX
#   complexity:  time O(n) per item · space O(n) for upper/lower groups
#   parameters:  rpbis = (M_correct - M_total) / SD_total * sqrt(p*q); acceptable >= 0.20
#   security:    N/A
#   invariants:
#     - Discrimination index in [-1.0, 1.0]
#     - Items with rpbis < 0.15 flagged for review
#     - Items with rpbis < 0.00 flagged as "negatively discriminating" (potential mis-key)
#
# ALGORITHM: Distractor analysis
#   source:      journey-os-algorithms-scholarly.html §IX
#   complexity:  time O(n*k) where n=students, k=options per item · space O(k)
#   parameters:  selection frequency per option; effective distractor = chosen by >= 5% of students
#   security:    N/A
#   invariants:
#     - Every distractor must have selection_count >= 0
#     - Non-functional distractors (chosen by < 5%) flagged for revision

## Summary
Build the post-exam item analytics engine that computes p-values (difficulty), point-biserial discrimination indices, and distractor effectiveness for every assessment item after exam sessions complete.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to see item-level analytics (difficulty, discrimination, distractor effectiveness) after an exam, so that I can identify poorly performing items and improve the assessment bank.

## Why this matters
Without item analytics, faculty have no data-driven way to identify bad items. Mis-keyed items, non-functional distractors, and items that fail to discriminate between high and low performers silently degrade exam quality. This is the foundation for all downstream analytics (KR-20, DIF, at-risk detection) and is a prerequisite for LCME compliance evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] ItemAnalyticsService computes p-value (difficulty index) for each item: correct / total attempts
- [ ] ItemAnalyticsService computes point-biserial discrimination index for each item
- [ ] ItemAnalyticsService computes distractor analysis: selection frequency per option, flags non-functional distractors (< 5% selection)
- [ ] Items flagged: too_easy (p > 0.90), too_hard (p < 0.20), poor_discrimination (rpbis < 0.15), negative_discrimination (rpbis < 0.00)
- [ ] API route GET /api/admin/analytics/items?exam_id=X returns paginated item analytics
- [ ] API route requires admin or faculty role (RLS enforced)
- [ ] ItemAnalyticsDashboard displays sortable table with p-value, discrimination, flag badges
- [ ] Analytics computed from session_answers + attempts tables (never from Neo4j)
- [ ] Feature scaffold: types.ts, index.ts, repository created for analytics feature slice
- [ ] All computations are O(n*k) or better — no N+1 queries

## Schema changes
```sql
-- item_analytics materialized view or table for caching computed analytics
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS item_analytics (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assessment_item_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_items(id),
  exam_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES exams(id),
  p_value NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL CHECK (p_value BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  discrimination_index NUMERIC(5,4) NOT NULL CHECK (discrimination_index BETWEEN -1 AND 1),
  total_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  correct_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  distractor_analysis JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  flags TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  institution_id UUID NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(assessment_item_id, exam_id)
);

-- RLS: admin and faculty only
ALTER TABLE item_analytics ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Faculty and admin read item_analytics"
  ON item_analytics FOR SELECT
  USING (institution_id = auth.jwt() ->> 'institution_id');

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## API contract
```
GET /api/admin/analytics/items?exam_id={uuid}&page={number}&per_page={number}&sort_by={p_value|discrimination_index|flags}&order={asc|desc}
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: {
  data: {
    items: [{
      assessment_item_id: string,
      stem_preview: string,
      p_value: number,
      discrimination_index: number,
      total_attempts: number,
      correct_count: number,
      distractor_analysis: [{ option_label: string, selection_count: number, is_correct: boolean, is_functional: boolean }],
      flags: string[]
    }],
    summary: {
      total_items: number,
      avg_p_value: number,
      avg_discrimination: number,
      flagged_count: number
    },
    pagination: { page: number, per_page: number, total: number }
  },
  error: null
}
Error: { data: null, error: { code: string, message: string } }
```

```typescript
// features/analytics/types.ts
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

export type ItemAnalyticsRow = Row<'item_analytics'>;

export interface DistractorAnalysis {
  option_label: string;
  selection_count: number;
  is_correct: boolean;
  is_functional: boolean; // >= 5% selection rate
}

export type ItemFlag = 'too_easy' | 'too_hard' | 'poor_discrimination' | 'negative_discrimination' | 'non_functional_distractor';

// Pattern: Service computation
// features/analytics/services/ItemAnalyticsService.ts
export class ItemAnalyticsService {
  // p-value: proportion correct
  static computePValue(correct: number, total: number): number {
    if (total === 0) return 0;
    return correct / total;
  }

  // Point-biserial discrimination
  static computeDiscrimination(
    itemScores: boolean[], // correct/incorrect per student
    totalScores: number[]  // total exam score per student
  ): number {
    // rpbis = (M_correct - M_total) / SD_total * sqrt(p * q)
  }
}

// Pattern: Repository with RPC for aggregation
// features/analytics/repositories/ItemAnalyticsRepository.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';

export class ItemAnalyticsRepository {
  async getItemResponseMatrix(examId: string) {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    // Single RPC call — not N+1 queries
    return supabase.rpc('get_item_response_matrix', { p_exam_id: examId });
  }
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E09/E09-S01.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/analytics/items returns item analytics for exam', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'faculty');
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/analytics/items?exam_id=test-exam-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.items).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.summary.total_items).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  // Verify p-values are in valid range
  for (const item of data.items) {
    expect(item.p_value).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(item.p_value).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(item.discrimination_index).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(-1);
    expect(item.discrimination_index).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
  }
});

test('GET /api/admin/analytics/items flags too-easy items', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'faculty');
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/analytics/items?exam_id=test-exam-id&sort_by=p_value&order=desc', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  const easyItems = data.items.filter((i: any) => i.p_value > 0.90);
  for (const item of easyItems) {
    expect(item.flags).toContain('too_easy');
  }
});

test('Negative: student role cannot access item analytics', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/analytics/items?exam_id=test-exam-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});
```
